findings.finding: Challenge artifact assertions can escape the project through a symlinked parent directory
findings.plain_english_risk: A committed challenge can claim PASS using an external file, so the receipt can certify evidence that is not contained in or produced by the reviewed project.
evidence: Reproduction: root/linked -> external directory; success.artifact=linked/proof.txt returned ('PASS', [])
findings.recommended_fix: Resolve each asserted artifact strictly, require the resolved path to remain under the resolved project root, and reject any symlink in the path chain; add a regression test for a symlinked parent directory.

findings.finding: Challenge timeout leaves descendant processes running
findings.plain_english_risk: A timed-out verifier can keep mutating files, consuming resources, or handling inherited credentials after CheckYourself reports the challenge as stopped.
findings.recommended_fix: Start challenges in an isolated process group/session, terminate the whole group on timeout, escalate to a bounded kill when needed, and add a regression test that proves descendants are gone.

findings.finding: The coverage schema rejects the executed receipts required by the scoring workflow
findings.plain_english_risk: CheckYourself can mint and consume an EXECUTED challenge receipt, but its own coverage schema only accepts the incompatible caller-issued receipt shape, so a real evidence-bearing coverage artifact cannot pass canonical validation.
evidence: validate --kind coverage rejected all three executed receipts for missing caller-issued fields and argv command type
findings.recommended_fix: Add the executed-receipt shape to coverage.schema.json with a oneOf contract shared from challenge-result/receipt definitions, then add challenge-to-coverage-to-score schema validation tests.
